contentText:
The Ferrari Luce has a lot of glass, metallic finish, and rounded edges. In other words, it’s got Jony Ive all over it. | Image: Ferrari

Ferrari makes some of the fastest cars on the planet, so it's anyone's guess how the Italian automaker ended up being so incredibly late to the EV party. Long after most automakers have drastically scaled back their EV ambitions , cancelled battery-powered models , or curtailed factory plans , Ferrari emerges from the shadows with a real weird one: the all-electric Luce .

Ferrari unveiled the Luce Monday at the Vela di Calatrava, a massive architectural sporting complex located on the outskirts of Rome. In many ways it's the most anticipated and also the most over-hyped EV to come out since battery-powered models first arrived on the scene. An …
